title: Stash: pause work in progress
why_it_matters: Switching branches with unfinished edits can be awkward.
explanation: git stash tucks away uncommitted changes and gives you a clean folder. Do what you need on another branch, then git stash pop to bring the work back. Commit small and often, so you need stash less.
code:
git stash
git switch other-branch
git stash pop
try_it: Stash a change, check git status, then pop it.
